text:
alice: Kicking off v2 cutover in the 18:00 UTC window. deploy-bot will flip the gateway flag at +10m. Watch the deploy channel and /alerts. Please confirm clients pinned.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment 'v2-api-cutover' by alice at 1736500060. Steps: prechecks -> traffic shift -> postcheck. Set operator eyes.

carla: Wait - analytics is migrating schema in same window. GA events will add `client.version` property name change. Some IoT devices still send old payloads. Risk: v2 validation rejects them.

bob: Oof. Do we have graceful fallback? v2 requires `Accept-Version: 2` header but many mobile SDKs don't send it.

carla: Exactly. We have inbound header-negotiation middleware but not deployed to edge yet.

dinesh: Suggestion: hold cutover until the header shim is live OR enable compatibility mode on gateway that ignores missing header for 48h.

ellen: Prefer shim -> smaller blast radius. If we enable gateway compatibility, we must add a metric and an automated rollback if error-rate > 3% or latency p50 increases >50ms.

alice: OK. Plan: pause cutover. Deploy header-negotiation shim to edge (canary 5% first), run synthetic tests, then resume. Update release notes and client-migration doc.

carla: I'll queue the shim deploy. Can someone update release-notes: add migration instructions and timeline? Also add note about analytics schema change.

bob: I'll add a short blurb to release-notes and ping growth for the SDK owners. @mobile-sdk-team can you verify the rollout? ellen can you add rollback thresholds to the runbook?

ellen: On it. Rollback criteria: 5xx spike >2x baseline OR p99 latency > 2x for more than 2m. I'll update runbook and post link.

deploy-bot: Deploy 'header-negotiation-shim' scheduled by carla at 1736500150. Canary: 5% traffic for 15m.

alice: Thanks. After canary looks good, we re-evaluate and aim for traffic ramp at 23:00 UTC. If canary fails we'll roll back shim automatically and re-open cutover planning.

dinesh: Also add a quick curl example for clients who can't set header: `curl -H "Accept-Version: 2" https://api.redwood.example/v1/endpoint` in release notes.

carla: Added the curl snippet to the notes draft and pushed to docs branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1245

bob: pinging SDK owners now. Mobile SDK team please verify header rollout compatibility.

ellen: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/v2-cutover-shim

alice: OK closing for now — re-open thread when canary completes. :thumbsup:
